summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Rareview Systematic Equity ETF (RSEE) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in total market equity. The fund is an actively managed fund-of-funds that employs a long/short systematic strategy to provide exposure to global equity markets. RSEE was launched on Jan 20, 2022 and is issued by Rareview Funds.
